MENU_QUICK_DESC: Any two nations, any venue. The centre pass is yours.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Eight nations, two pools, semi-finals and a final.
MENU_CUP_CONTINUE: Your cup is under way. Carry on.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: The court, the seven positions and every rule the umpires call.
QUARTERS_NOTE: A real match is four quarters of 15 minutes. The clock runs on through goals and stops only for injuries.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: A league rule: in the last five minutes of each quarter a goal from 3 m or more out is worth two.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Their defenders are slow to read your passes and rarely take one.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: A good club side: they will take a loose pass.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: An international side: quick to read the play, hard to pass around.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: The best in the world. Every lazy pass is picked off.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: You play whoever has the ball, and the defender nearest it.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Team: you control whoever has the ball. One position: pick a bib on the home screen and play her all match, as a player does.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: On: your player stops at the edge of the areas her position may enter. Off: step over a line and the umpire calls offside.
POS_ROLE_GS: Scores the goals from close to the post.
POS_ROLE_GA: Scores, feeds the shooter and drives through the centre third.
POS_ROLE_WA: Feeds the circle from its edge; a first option at the centre pass.
POS_ROLE_C: Takes the centre pass and links defence to attack all over the court.
POS_ROLE_WD: Marks the Wing Attack and cuts off the feed into the circle.
POS_ROLE_GD: Marks the Goal Attack, in the circle and out of it.
POS_ROLE_GK: Marks the Goal Shooter, defends the shot and takes the rebound.
POS_AREAS_GS: Areas: the attacking third and the goal circle.
POS_AREAS_GA: Areas: the centre third, the attacking third and the goal circle.
POS_AREAS_WA: Areas: the centre third and the attacking third, not the circle.
POS_AREAS_C: Areas: all three thirds, neither circle.
POS_AREAS_WD: Areas: the centre third and the defending third, not the circle.
POS_AREAS_GD: Areas: the centre third, the defending third and the goal circle.
POS_AREAS_GK: Areas: the defending third and the goal circle.
GFX_NOTE: Low suits budget phones: no outlines, a smaller crowd. With Auto on, a match that runs slowly in its first seconds drops a level by itself.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: About {n} frames a second, drawn a little smaller: cooler and longer on a charge.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: {n} frames a second on your {hz} Hz screen: smooth, and kinder to the battery than the maximum.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: As many frames as your {hz} Hz screen shows.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Drag each button to where your thumb finds it. They stay there.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: An independent game. The teams are countries under their plain names; every player's name is invented. It is not connected with any governing body, league or competition.
LICENCES_INTRO: The game is built with free and open software. Its licences ask for these notices to be shown; they are in English, as written.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: 30.5 m long and 15.25 m wide, in three thirds. A centre circle 0.9 m across in the middle, and at each end a goal circle: a semicircle 4.9 m from the goal post. The ring is 3.05 m up, with no backboard.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Each player wears a bib with her position, and may go only into her position's areas. A team names up to twelve; changes are made at the intervals, after a goal on request, and for injury.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Only the Goal Shooter and Goal Attack may score, and only from inside the goal circle. The ball must go right through the ring. A shot that leaves her hands before the whistle counts.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Every quarter starts with a centre pass, and so does play after every goal. They alternate, whoever scored. The Centre stands in the centre circle; the others wait in their goal thirds until the whistle, and the pass must be caught in the centre third.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Four quarters of 15 minutes, with four minutes between the first and second and the third and fourth, and twelve at half-time. The teams change ends each quarter.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: When a match must have a winner and is level: two halves of up to seven minutes with a minute between them, then play goes on until one team is two goals ahead.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: With the ball she may not run. The foot she lands on is her landing foot: she may step with the other and pivot on it, but once she lifts it she must pass or shoot before it touches the floor again. A free pass to the other side.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: She must pass or shoot within three seconds of catching the ball. Held ball: a free pass.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: A defender trying to block or take the ball must stand at least 0.9 m from the landing foot of the player with it. Closer, it is obstruction: a penalty pass.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: No contact that interferes with an opponent's play: pushing, holding, knocking the ball from her hands, or not leaving a player who has won the ball room to land. A penalty pass.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: A player who steps into an area her position may not enter, with or without the ball, is offside. The lines are part of the areas they enclose. A free pass.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: The ball may not be thrown over a whole third without a player in that third catching or touching it. A free pass.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: There must be room for an opponent to intercept between the thrower and the catcher. A free pass.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: A ball that lands outside the court goes to the side that did not touch it last: a throw-in from where it crossed the line, taken within three seconds.
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: A free pass is taken where the fault was, by any player allowed there. For a penalty pass the player penalised stands beside the thrower, out of play, until the ball is released. In the goal circle a penalty may be a pass or a shot.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: The umpire lets play run on when stopping it would cost the team that was fouled: a shooter about to shoot, say. She calls the advantage and the foul.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: For repeated or dangerous play an umpire may warn a player, suspend her for two minutes of playing time, or order her off. Since 2024 there is no toss-up: when two players offend at once, the team last with the ball keeps it.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Some leagues play variations. The game offers the Double Zone: in the last five minutes of each quarter, a goal from 3 m or more from the post counts two.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: The left thumb anywhere on the left of the screen is a joystick: it runs your player (the lime ring). Lead into space to get free for a pass.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: With the ball she cannot run. Push the stick toward a team-mate to pick her (a ring shows who), then PASS for a chest or shoulder pass, or LOB to go over a defender. The ring over the ball is your three seconds.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: SHOOT appears when your Goal Shooter or Goal Attack has the ball in the circle. Closer is surer; a defender's arm over the ball makes it harder.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: DEFEND puts your arms up over the ball. Watch the ring round her landing foot: green is legal, red is closer than 0.9 m and the umpire will call obstruction.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: INTERCEPT leaps for a pass in the air if you can reach it in time. Lunge at a player holding the ball and it is contact.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Playing as the team, you control whoever has the ball, and SWITCH moves you to the defender nearest it. Pick a bib on the home screen to play one position all match.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD or the arrows to move, Space for the first button, J and K for the others, Esc to pause.
INTERVAL_NOTE: The interval is {min} minutes; Continue starts {next} now.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Tap a position to bring on the next player from the bench who plays it.
CUP_ABOUT: Eight nations near your own in the world ranking, in two pools of four. The top two of each go through to the semi-finals; then the final and the match for bronze. Two points for a win, one for a draw, ties split by goal percentage.
CUP_OUT: You are out. The cup plays on without you.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Play a match and your records start here.
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: A league rule: each side may call two 90-second time-outs a half, after a goal. Yours is in the pause menu.
ROLLING_NOTE: A league rule: make team changes at any time from the pause menu, not only at the intervals.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: 90 seconds, with time held. Make team changes now; Continue when you are ready.
INJURY_NOTE: A {team} player is hurt. The team has 30 seconds to help her off; both teams may make changes. Continue when you are ready.
